member.name: M:VisualComponents.UX.Shared.JointSlider.OnValueChanged(System.Double,System.Double)
member.summary: Updates everything related to the value, called when changes.
member.param: old value (within limits)
new value (within limits)
member.remarks: This is called only when the value changes within the limit. When the user changes the value to be outside limit, the value is clamped and `this.Value` changes, but only the first time. If the next value is _also_ outside the limit, it is clamped to be the same value as before => no change.

member.name: M:VisualComponents.UX.Shared.JointSlider.OnRealValueChanged
member.summary: Updates some things related to the value, called every time the value changes
member.remarks:
- This method is called before OnRealValueChanged, but they are not mutually exclusive. If the value is within limits, the OnValueChanged will be called. There are cases, which are valid, but OnValueChanged is not called, so we call it here explicitly. 1. value is on a limit 2. value is slightly outside the limit due to floating point calculations
- Note that this.Value is not evaluated at this point.

member.name: F:VisualComponents.UX.Shared.VirtualizingCanvas.AheadRealizationViewportFractionProperty
member.summary: Defines the fraction of viewport that will participate in the query, so that the items which intersect the bounds of the viewport AND its fraction will be realized (can be used for smoother panning, because items that are not yet in the viewport will be pre-loaded). member.summary: Gets or sets the Rect bounds of an item which allows canvas to realize it again after it was virtualized (it won't know that the item is back into visible area otherwise). Setting an item's bounds to Rect.Empty guarantees it to be realized immediately. Setting approximate bounds is fine as the canvas will correct them during the Arrange pass. Use with care.
member.remarks: This is the main interface between data side and virtualization in this canvas.

member.summary: Sets the visibility status of the ContentPanes which hold a screen of the specified type. If the screen is set to be shown, all the matching hidden panes are shown, and if no matches are found, a new one is created.
